warmup: getent hosts linkwarden-search || printf '127.0.0.1 linkwarden-search\n' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
yarn workspace @linkwarden/web exec playwright install chromium
install: getent hosts linkwarden-search || printf '127.0.0.1 linkwarden-search\n' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
yarn workspace @linkwarden/web exec playwright install chromium

db.cmd: docker start -a linkwarden-db || exec docker run --name linkwarden-db -e POSTGRES_USER -e POSTGRES_DB -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 -v linkwarden-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16-alpine

search.cmd: docker start -a linkwarden-search || exec docker run --name linkwarden-search -e MEILI_MASTER_KEY -p 7700:7700 -v linkwarden-meili:/meili_data getmeili/meilisearch:v1.13.3

web.cmd: timeout 120 bash -c 'until docker exec linkwarden-db pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -q 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && yarn prisma:deploy && exec yarn web:dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p "$PORT"

worker.cmd: timeout 180 bash -c 'until curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/config >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$MEILI_HOST/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && exec yarn worker:dev
